words.enDefinition: A formal message from a public authority about official business

examples.en: The government notice identified the office responsible for my file.
examples.zh: 这份「政务通知」写明了负责我档案的办事处。

examples.en: My tutor used a sample government notice in our language workshop.
examples.zh: 导师在我们的语言课上用了一份「政务通知」的样本。

words.enDefinition: Letters or messages exchanged with a government body about official business

examples.en: I saved the agency correspondence in the same folder as my paperwork.
examples.zh: 我把「政务机构往来函件」和申请材料放在同一个文件夹。

examples.en: The adviser helped me put the agency correspondence in date order.
examples.zh: 顾问帮我按日期排好了「政务机构往来函件」。

words.enDefinition: An identifier assigned to a particular official notice by its issuer

examples.en: I used the notice number to find the matching letter online.
examples.zh: 我用「通知编号」在网上找到了对应的信件。

examples.en: The notice number appeared above the heading on the second page.
examples.zh: 「通知编号」印在第二页的标题上方。

words.enDefinition: An identifier an agency uses to track a particular case

examples.en: The clerk read back my case number before opening the file.
examples.zh: 办事员复述了我的「案件编号」，才打开档案。

examples.en: I checked whether both messages referred to the same case number.
examples.zh: 我核对了两条消息是不是提到了同一个「案件编号」。

collocations: a letter with your case number

words.enDefinition: The date shown on an official notice, generally indicating its issue

examples.en: The notice date was different from the day the envelope arrived.
examples.zh: 「通知日期」与收到信封的那一天不同。

examples.en: I circled the notice date on my printout before the meeting.
examples.zh: 见面前，我在打印件上圈出了「通知日期」。

words.enDefinition: The means used to officially deliver a notice or document

examples.en: The form listed the method of service next to the recipient's address.
examples.zh: 表格在收件人地址旁列明了「正式送达方式」。

examples.en: I checked whether the method of service was described in the case file.
examples.zh: 我查看了案卷里是否说明了「正式送达方式」。

words.enDefinition: A recipient's formal confirmation of receipt of an official document

examples.en: I checked the date on the acknowledgment of service before returning the form.
examples.zh: 我交回表格前，核对了「正式送达确认书」上的日期。

examples.en: The office kept the acknowledgment of service behind the envelope in my file.
examples.zh: 办事处把「正式送达确认书」放在案卷里的信封后。

words.enDefinition: Formal delivery of documents using an authorized electronic channel

examples.en: The agency explained how it recorded electronic service in its online system.
examples.zh: 政务机构说明了在线系统如何登记「电子送达」。

examples.en: The guide listed electronic service alongside the methods using paper documents.
examples.zh: 指南把「电子送达」与送达纸质文件的方式并列介绍。

words.enDefinition: Formal delivery of a document directly to its intended recipient

examples.en: The clerk explained why the record listed personal service for that notice.
examples.zh: 办事员说明了为什么记录把那份通知标为「当面送达」。

examples.en: I asked where the guide defined personal service in this context.
examples.zh: 我问指南在哪里解释了此处的「当面送达」。

words.enDefinition: An official notification issued in printed form

examples.en: I compared the paper notice with the version in the portal.
examples.zh: 我把「纸质通知」与平台里的版本作了比较。

examples.en: The clerk asked which line appeared on my paper notice.
examples.zh: 办事员问我的「纸质通知」上是哪一行写着这项内容。

collocations: a copy of a paper notice

words.enDefinition: A protected online area for exchanging messages with an agency

examples.en: I found the notice in the secure message centre after signing in.
examples.zh: 登录后，我在「安全消息中心」找到了通知。

examples.en: The agency confirmed that my response was in the secure message centre.
examples.zh: 政务机构确认，我的答复在「安全消息中心」里。

collocations: reply in the secure message centre
a message in the secure message centre

words.enDefinition: An online view displaying the latest information about a case

examples.en: My case dashboard showed a new message next to the latest status.
examples.zh: 「案件总览页面」在最新状态旁显示有新消息。

examples.en: I opened the case dashboard to see which reference matched the letter.
examples.zh: 我打开「案件总览页面」，看哪个编号与信件一致。

collocations: a link to the case dashboard

words.enDefinition: A chronological account of key events in an official case

examples.en: The case timeline showed the dates of both messages in order.
examples.zh: 「案件进度时间线」按先后顺序显示了两条消息的日期。

examples.en: I compared my saved letter with the case timeline on the portal.
examples.zh: 我把保存的信件与平台上的「案件进度时间线」作了核对。

collocations: an entry on the case timeline

words.enDefinition: A list of past letters or messages attached to a case

examples.en: The older notice was visible in my correspondence history on the portal.
examples.zh: 我可以在政务平台的「往来函件记录」里查看较早的通知。

examples.en: I checked the correspondence history to see which message had come first.
examples.zh: 我查看了「往来函件记录」，确认哪条消息先到。

collocations: an item in the correspondence history

words.enDefinition: To save a local copy of a notice from an account

examples.en: I used the link to download the notice and saved it for reference.
examples.zh: 我用链接「下载通知」，保存下来供将来查阅。

examples.en: The clerk showed me where to download the notice on that screen.
examples.zh: 办事员指给我看，那个页面的什么位置可以「下载通知」。

collocations: a link to download the notice
ask how to download the notice

words.enDefinition: To send a response using the agency's online system

examples.en: The notice said I could reply through the portal if I preferred writing.
examples.zh: 通知上说，我更愿意用文字答复的话，可以「通过政务平台回复」。

examples.en: I checked whether we could reply through the portal with a short question.
examples.zh: 我核对了能不能「通过政务平台回复」，简短问个问题。

collocations: ask whether to reply through the portal
an option to reply through the portal
be able to reply through the portal

words.enDefinition: Confirmation that an office received documents, a submission, or correspondence

examples.en: The department sent an acknowledgment of receipt before posting any status update.
examples.zh: 部门在发布进度消息之前，先发了「收件确认」。

examples.en: I kept the acknowledgment of receipt with a copy of the original letter.
examples.zh: 我把「收件确认」与原信的副本放在一起保存。

words.enDefinition: The recorded date on which an office received something

examples.en: The form showed a date received for each of my letters.
examples.zh: 表格给我的每封信都标了「收件日期」。

examples.en: I compared the date received with the label on my tracking form.
examples.zh: 我把「收件日期」和跟踪表上的标记作了核对。

words.enDefinition: A message reporting the current position or progress of a case

examples.en: I received a case status update while waiting for the written notice.
examples.zh: 我在等书面通知时，收到了一条「案件状态更新」。

examples.en: The case status update identified the department currently holding my file.
examples.zh: 「案件状态更新」写明了目前是哪个部门在保管我的案卷。

words.enDefinition: A label introducing the date an online record last changed

examples.en: I found "Last updated on" beneath the status heading on the page.
examples.zh: 我在页面的状态标题下方找到了「上次更新于」。

examples.en: The page read "Last updated on Monday," so I checked the dates.
examples.zh: 页面显示「上次更新于星期一」，我便核对了几份通知。

collocations: last updated on the date shown
a label reading last updated on
look for the last updated on label

words.enDefinition: A notification produced automatically by an agency's computer system

examples.en: The system-generated notice appeared right after the clerk recorded my file.
examples.zh: 办事员登记案卷后，平台马上显示了「系统自动生成的通知」。

examples.en: An adviser explained the heading on the system-generated notice I received.
examples.zh: 顾问解释了我收到的「系统自动生成的通知」上的标题。

collocations: a system-generated notice in the portal

words.enDefinition: Words indicating that an authority has formally released a notice

examples.en: The online record said the notice was issued earlier that morning.
examples.zh: 在线记录上写着，那天早上「通知已经发出」。

examples.en: The clerk confirmed the notice was issued after my file was reviewed.
examples.zh: 办事员确认，案卷审核后「通知已经发出」。

collocations: the notice was issued by the agency
the notice was issued on the date shown

words.enDefinition: A USCIS notice communicating action or information about a filing

examples.en: The US guide showed a blank Notice of Action for reference.
examples.zh: 美国指南展示了一份空白的「美国移民局办理通知」供参考。

examples.en: I checked which case was named on the Notice of Action.
examples.zh: 我核对了「美国移民局办理通知」上写的是哪个案件。

collocations: a Notice of Action from USCIS
details on a Notice of Action

words.enDefinition: Obtaining a copy of a notice already held in a system

examples.en: The portal had a separate option for notice retrieval after signing in.
examples.zh: 登录后，平台有一个单独的「调取通知」选项。

examples.en: I asked whether the office could help with notice retrieval for older files.
examples.zh: 我问办事处能否协助从旧档案中「调取通知」。

words.enDefinition: Items sent inside the envelope along with a letter

examples.en: The final line listed the enclosures included with the letter.
examples.zh: 信件最后一行列出了「随函附送文件」。

examples.en: I put the enclosures behind the main notice in my folder.
examples.zh: 我把「随函附送文件」放在文件夹里的主通知后面。

words.enDefinition: A letter sent with other papers explaining what they contain

examples.en: The covering letter explained why the office had returned the certificate.
examples.zh: 「随件说明函」解释了办事处为什么把证书退了回来。

examples.en: The clerk asked which documents the covering letter referred to.
examples.zh: 办事员问「随件说明函」指的是哪些文件。

collocations: a copy of the covering letter

words.enDefinition: A notice confirming receipt of a filing by a government office

examples.en: The US office described the receipt notice separately from a decision.
examples.zh: 美国办事处把「申请收件通知」与决定分开介绍。

examples.en: I found the receipt notice in a folder with the original form.
examples.zh: 我在装有原始表格的文件夹中找到了「申请收件通知」。

collocations: the date on a receipt notice

words.enDefinition: A status meaning an office has agreed to process a request

examples.en: The portal showed my file as accepted for processing after the initial checks.
examples.zh: 初步检查后，政务平台把我的案卷标为「已受理办理」。

examples.en: The clerk explained what accepted for processing meant for my file's stage.
examples.zh: 办事员解释了「已受理办理」表示我的案卷到了哪个阶段。

collocations: mark a request accepted for processing
notice that a file was accepted for processing

words.enDefinition: Sent back before an authority processed the submission

examples.en: The envelope said the documents were returned without processing by the office.
examples.zh: 信封上的说明写着，办事处将这些文件「未受理即退回」。

examples.en: I asked why my package was marked returned without processing in the record.
examples.zh: 我问记录为何把我的材料包标为「未受理即退回」。

collocations: a notice saying returned without processing

words.enDefinition: A case status indicating a particular officer has received responsibility

examples.en: The tracker showed my file was assigned to an officer the previous week.
examples.zh: 进度页面显示，我的案卷上星期就「已分派给办理人员」。

examples.en: I received a message saying the case had been assigned to an officer.
examples.zh: 我收到消息，说案件「已分派给办理人员」。

collocations: a case assigned to an officer
mark a file assigned to an officer
confirmation that a case was assigned to an officer

words.enDefinition: Words indicating that a case is still awaiting a decision

examples.en: The page said the case is pending under the file number.
examples.zh: 页面在案卷编号下显示「案件尚待处理」。

examples.en: I saved the message that said the case is pending this morning.
examples.zh: 我保存了今天上午那条写有「案件尚待处理」的消息。

collocations: a notice saying the case is pending

words.enDefinition: A status meaning that confirmation of certain information remains outstanding

examples.en: The portal marked one item pending verification after I sent the letter.
examples.zh: 我发出信件后，政务平台把一项内容标为「尚待核验」。

examples.en: The officer told me which part of the file was pending verification.
examples.zh: 工作人员告诉我，案卷的哪一部分「尚待核验」。

words.enDefinition: Checking official information through records held by another public body

examples.en: The notice listed interagency verification separately from the main document check.
examples.zh: 通知把「跨机构核验」与主要文件审查分开列出。

examples.en: I asked what information the interagency verification section referred to.
examples.zh: 我问「跨机构核验」一节指的是哪些信息。

words.enDefinition: Moved to a different office for handling or a decision

examples.en: I learned my case had been transferred to another office after checking the portal.
examples.zh: 查看平台后，我得知我的案件「已转交另一个办事处」。

examples.en: The letter explained why the file was transferred to another office last month.
examples.zh: 信件解释了案卷上个月为何「已转交另一个办事处」。

collocations: a case transferred to another office
a file transferred to another office
confirmation that it was transferred to another office

words.enDefinition: Waiting for information or confirmation from an outside organization or person

examples.en: The portal listed one item as awaiting third-party confirmation on the checklist.
examples.zh: 政务平台在清单上把一项内容列为「等待第三方确认」。

examples.en: My adviser explained that the phrase awaiting third-party confirmation described that step.
examples.zh: 顾问解释，那个步骤用「等待第三方确认」来描述。

collocations: show a file as awaiting third-party confirmation

words.enDefinition: Words indicating that work on a previously paused file has restarted

examples.en: The file timeline said processing resumed after the new notice was received.
examples.zh: 案卷时间线显示，收到新通知后「已恢复办理」。

examples.en: I saw the words processing resumed under the heading for recent activity.
examples.zh: 我在最近动态标题下看到了「已恢复办理」。

collocations: a timeline entry saying processing resumed

words.enDefinition: Opened again after closing so the agency can examine it

examples.en: The agency said our file was reopened for review after the correction.
examples.zh: 政务机构说，更正之后我们的案卷「已重新开启审查」。

examples.en: The earlier case was marked reopened for review on my dashboard.
examples.zh: 案件总览页面中，较早的案件被标为「已重新开启审查」。

collocations: notice that a file was reopened for review

words.enDefinition: Closed by an administrative action without necessarily resolving the merits

examples.en: My copy said the case was administratively closed under that heading.
examples.zh: 我的副本在那个标题下写着案件「已作行政结案」。

examples.en: I asked which letter explained why the file was administratively closed.
examples.zh: 我问哪封信说明了案卷为何「已作行政结案」。

words.enDefinition: Treated by an authority as withdrawn under the applicable rules

examples.en: The clerk explained the words deemed withdrawn on the case page.
examples.zh: 办事员解释了案件页面上的「视为撤回」是什么意思。

examples.en: I checked which request the notice said was deemed withdrawn.
examples.zh: 我查了一下，通知说哪项申请被「视为撤回」。

collocations: record a case as deemed withdrawn

words.enDefinition: A status saying an application has ceased to be active

examples.en: The agency's letter showed the words application lapsed beside the reference.
examples.zh: 政务机构的信在编号旁写了「申请已失效」。

examples.en: I asked what application lapsed meant in that part of the portal.
examples.zh: 我问平台那一部分的「申请已失效」指什么。

words.enDefinition: A message advising that work on a case is taking longer

examples.en: I saved the processing delay notice with the letter from the previous week.
examples.zh: 我把「办理延误通知」与上一周收到的信放在一起保存。

examples.en: The processing delay notice had a different subject line from earlier messages.
examples.zh: 「办理延误通知」的主题与早先的消息不同。

words.enDefinition: A request asking a public agency about a case's progress

examples.en: I used a case status inquiry to confirm which office had my file.
examples.zh: 我发起「案件进度查询」，确认我的案卷在哪个办事处。

examples.en: The office acknowledged my case status inquiry in a separate message.
examples.zh: 办事处另发消息确认收到了我的「案件进度查询」。

collocations: respond to a case status inquiry

words.enDefinition: The staff group responsible for handling a case or filing

examples.en: The case processing team sent a short update before the letter arrived.
examples.zh: 信件到达前，「案件办理团队」发了一条简短的进度更新。

examples.en: I asked which case processing team handled the older applications from that region.
examples.zh: 我问该地区较早的申请由哪个「案件办理团队」负责。

collocations: an update from the case processing team
refer a file to the case processing team

words.enDefinition: A USCIS notice asking for more evidence while a case is pending

examples.en: The US guide showed where a Request for Evidence listed the items needed.
examples.zh: 美国指南指出了「美国移民局补证通知」在哪一栏列出所需材料。

examples.en: My adviser explained the heading on the Request for Evidence in the sample.
examples.zh: 顾问解释了样本中「美国移民局补证通知」的标题。

collocations: respond to a Request for Evidence
a Request for Evidence from USCIS

words.enDefinition: A formal notice asking someone for more information about a case

examples.en: I checked which request the notice to provide further information referred to in the file.
examples.zh: 我核对了案卷里的「要求补充信息的通知」指哪项申请。

examples.en: The notice to provide further information listed a separate contact address for questions.
examples.zh: 「要求补充信息的通知」另外列了一个咨询地址。

collocations: issue a notice to provide further information
read a notice to provide further information
details in a notice to provide further information

words.enDefinition: A formal request to explain an unclear statement or detail

examples.en: The agency sent a request for clarification about one sentence in my statement.
examples.zh: 政务机构就我声明中的一句话发来了「澄清说明请求」。

examples.en: I read the request for clarification before comparing the two records again.
examples.zh: 我先读了「澄清说明请求」，然后再次比较两份记录。

words.enDefinition: Further material provided in addition to the evidence already available

examples.en: The clerk sent my supplementary evidence to the team handling my file.
examples.zh: 办事员把我的「补充证据」转交给了办理团队。

examples.en: I kept the supplementary evidence separate from the documents I sent first.
examples.zh: 我将「补充证据」与最初寄出的文件分开保存。

words.enDefinition: Evidence that an office has already recorded for a case

examples.en: The officer checked the evidence on file before asking about the other letter.
examples.zh: 工作人员先核查了「案卷内已有证据」，才问起另一封信。

examples.en: I asked which entry described the evidence on file on the portal.
examples.zh: 我问平台的哪个条目介绍了「案卷内已有证据」。

words.enDefinition: A status confirming that an office received a reply

examples.en: My portal showed response received next to the date of my letter.
examples.zh: 政务平台在我的信件日期旁显示「答复已收到」。

examples.en: I saved a copy of the screen marked response received for my file.
examples.zh: 我保存了一张标记为「答复已收到」的页面截图归档。

words.enDefinition: A request made earlier that still needs a response

examples.en: I asked which outstanding request was mentioned in the status message.
examples.zh: 我问状态消息里提到的是哪项「尚未答复的请求」。

examples.en: The officer linked the outstanding request to an earlier notice on file.
examples.zh: 工作人员把「尚未答复的请求」关联到案卷中较早的通知。

words.enDefinition: A USCIS notice stating that the agency proposes denying a request

examples.en: The US guide distinguishes a Notice of Intent to Deny from a final decision.
examples.zh: 美国指南区分了「美国移民局拟拒通知」和最终决定。

examples.en: The adviser pointed out the heading on the sample Notice of Intent to Deny.
examples.zh: 顾问指了指「美国移民局拟拒通知」样本上的标题。

collocations: issue a Notice of Intent to Deny
receive a Notice of Intent to Deny
a response to a Notice of Intent to Deny

words.zhGloss: 加拿大程序公正通知函
words.enDefinition: An IRCC letter giving a person an opportunity to address concerns
acceptedZhAnswers: 加拿大程序公正通知函

examples.en: The Canadian adviser explained what a procedural fairness letter normally addresses.
examples.zh: 加拿大顾问解释了「加拿大程序公正通知函」通常涉及哪些事项。

examples.en: The sample procedural fairness letter separated the officer's concerns into two headings.
examples.zh: 「加拿大程序公正通知函」样本用两个标题分别列出工作人员的疑问。

collocations: respond to a procedural fairness letter
concerns in a procedural fairness letter

words.enDefinition: A formal request giving someone an opportunity to express their views

examples.en: The invitation to comment listed the points the agency wanted us to address.
examples.zh: 「邀请陈述意见」列出了政务机构希望我们回应的要点。

examples.en: I asked which letter contained the invitation to comment for that review.
examples.zh: 我问哪封信包含那次复核的「邀请陈述意见」。

collocations: respond to an invitation to comment
an invitation to comment on the findings

words.enDefinition: To send a written response instead of giving it orally

examples.en: The clerk explained whom to contact if I wanted to reply in writing.
examples.zh: 办事员解释了如果我想「以书面形式答复」，应联系谁。

examples.en: The agency invited us to reply in writing with comments on the summary.
examples.zh: 政务机构邀请我们就概要「以书面形式答复」，提出意见。

collocations: ask someone to reply in writing
be told to reply in writing

words.enDefinition: A review an authority may choose whether to undertake

examples.en: The guide explained what discretionary review meant in that type of case.
examples.zh: 指南解释了该类案件中的「酌情审查」指什么。

examples.en: I asked which panel handled discretionary review in the sample process.
examples.zh: 我问示例流程中的「酌情审查」由哪个小组负责。

words.enDefinition: Words saying a person formally took back an earlier request

examples.en: The notice said the request was withdrawn before a decision was made.
examples.zh: 通知说，作出决定前「请求已撤回」。

examples.en: The officer confirmed the request was withdrawn and listed the recorded date.
examples.zh: 工作人员确认「请求已撤回」，并列出了记录日期。

collocations: a note saying the request was withdrawn
record that the request was withdrawn

words.enDefinition: A formal notification explaining the outcome of an official decision

examples.en: The notice of decision listed the decision and its date on the front.
examples.zh: 「决定通知书」正面写了决定及其日期。

examples.en: I compared the notice of decision with the outcome shown on the portal.
examples.zh: 我把「决定通知书」与政务平台上显示的结果核对了一下。

collocations: the date on a notice of decision

words.enDefinition: An official notice confirming an authority approved a request

examples.en: The agency listed a separate reference on the notice of approval.
examples.zh: 政务机构在「批准通知书」上另列了一个编号。

examples.en: I saved the notice of approval beside the copy of my original paperwork.
examples.zh: 我把「批准通知书」和原申请材料的副本放在一起。

collocations: a copy of the notice of approval

words.enDefinition: An official notification that an authority refused a request

examples.en: The notice of refusal included a summary of the reasons below the heading.
examples.zh: 「拒绝通知书」在标题下方概括了拒绝的理由。

examples.en: I checked the file number shown on the notice of refusal before calling.
examples.zh: 打电话咨询前，我核对了「拒绝通知书」上显示的案卷编号。

collocations: reasons in a notice of refusal

words.enDefinition: An approval that depends on specified conditions being satisfied

examples.en: The letter stated conditional approval and referred us to the enclosed conditions.
examples.zh: 信件写明了「附条件批准」，并提示我们查看随函附上的条件。

examples.en: I asked which notice explained the details of my conditional approval.
examples.zh: 我问哪份通知详细说明了我的「附条件批准」。

words.enDefinition: A preliminary approval indicating agreement before a process is finalized

examples.en: The guide used approval in principle for an earlier stage of the process.
examples.zh: 指南用「原则上批准」来表示流程中前面的一个阶段。

examples.en: The note labeled approval in principle appeared separately from the final letter.
examples.zh: 标为「原则上批准」的备注与最终信函是分开的。

collocations: a letter confirming approval in principle

words.enDefinition: Words introducing the conditions applying to a particular approval

examples.en: The letter said "Approved subject to the listed conditions" beneath the heading.
examples.zh: 信在标题下写着「获批但须满足所列条件」。

examples.en: I asked what "Approved subject to verification" meant on the sample notice.
examples.zh: 我问通知样本上的「获批但须完成核验」是什么意思。

collocations: approved subject to the listed conditions
approved subject to the terms stated

words.enDefinition: The concluding formal decision of a particular official process

examples.en: The agency sent its final determination in a separate written notice.
examples.zh: 政务机构单独发了书面通知告知「最终裁定」。

examples.en: I checked which reference the final determination listed for the case.
examples.zh: 我核对了「最终裁定」为这个案件列出的编号。

collocations: the date of a final determination

words.enDefinition: A formal explanation of the basis for an official decision

examples.en: The statement of reasons referred to documents listed earlier in the file.
examples.zh: 「决定理由说明」提到了案卷前面列出的文件。

examples.en: I asked which page contained the statement of reasons for this decision.
examples.zh: 我问这一决定的「决定理由说明」在哪一页。

words.enDefinition: The stated reasons or basis for refusing a request

examples.en: The agency set out its grounds for refusal under three separate headings.
examples.zh: 政务机构用三个标题列明了「拒绝理由」。

examples.en: I read the grounds for refusal before comparing them with the case summary.
examples.zh: 我先读了「拒绝理由」，再拿它们和案情概要作比较。

collocations: grounds for refusal in a notice

words.enDefinition: Notes recording why an official reached a particular decision

examples.en: The Canadian guide described officer decision notes separately from the refusal letter.
examples.zh: 加拿大指南把「审理人员决定记录」与拒绝通知分开介绍。

examples.en: I compared the officer decision notes with the summary at the top.
examples.zh: 我把「审理人员决定记录」与顶部的概要作了比较。

words.enDefinition: A decision with an unfavorable outcome for a person affected

examples.en: The adviser explained how the guide defined an adverse decision.
examples.zh: 顾问解释了指南怎样定义「对当事人不利的决定」。

examples.en: The notice identified the office that issued the adverse decision.
examples.zh: 通知写明了哪个办事处作出了「对当事人不利的决定」。

words.enDefinition: Declined at intake because items needed for processing were missing

examples.en: The office marked the file rejected as incomplete before it reached the reviewer.
examples.zh: 案卷进入审理前，办事处已将其标为「因材料不全被退回」。

examples.en: I asked which package the portal showed as rejected as incomplete.
examples.zh: 我问平台显示哪一份材料包「因材料不全被退回」。

collocations: a notice saying rejected as incomplete

words.enDefinition: Declined after considering the substantive facts and basis of the case

examples.en: The summary said the claim was refused on the merits after examination.
examples.zh: 概要写着，这项请求已经「经实质审查后拒绝」。

examples.en: I checked how the decision used the phrase refused on the merits.
examples.zh: 我核对了决定书怎样使用「经实质审查后拒绝」这个说法。

collocations: a claim refused on the merits
an application refused on the merits
notice that a claim was refused on the merits

words.enDefinition: A decision within the scope of a specified review process

examples.en: The Australian guide explained what a reviewable decision meant in that context.
examples.zh: 澳大利亚指南说明了那个语境下「可予复核的决定」是什么意思。

examples.en: I asked which part of the letter identified the reviewable decision.
examples.zh: 我问信里哪一部分说明了哪个是「可予复核的决定」。

collocations: a notice of a reviewable decision

words.enDefinition: A decision that may be challenged through a defined appeal procedure

examples.en: The adviser explained why the manual used the term appealable decision.
examples.zh: 顾问解释了手册为什么使用「可提出申诉的决定」这一术语。

examples.en: The sample labeled one of the outcomes an appealable decision.
examples.zh: 示例把其中一种结果标注为「可提出申诉的决定」。

collocations: a case involving an appealable decision

words.enDefinition: A notice explaining rights to seek review of a decision

examples.en: The decision packet included a notice of review rights after the main letter.
examples.zh: 决定材料包在主函后附了一份「复核权告知书」。

examples.en: My adviser pointed out the notice of review rights at the end of the packet.
examples.zh: 顾问指给我看材料包末尾的「复核权告知书」。

collocations: receive a notice of review rights
include a notice of review rights
read a notice of review rights

words.enDefinition: A recognized entitlement to challenge a decision through an appeal

examples.en: I asked where the notice discussed a possible right of appeal.
examples.zh: 我问通知在哪儿提到了可能适用的「申诉权」。

examples.en: The guide used right of appeal in a separate section about decisions.
examples.zh: 指南在讲决定的部分另设一节，介绍「申诉权」。

collocations: information about a right of appeal

words.enDefinition: A status indicating a decision has been deliberately postponed

examples.en: The portal showed decision deferred under the most recent case entry.
examples.zh: 政务平台在最新案件条目下面显示「暂缓作出决定」。

examples.en: The adviser explained the wording decision deferred on the summary sheet.
examples.zh: 顾问解释了概要表上「暂缓作出决定」的措辞。

words.enDefinition: Words introducing when a formal decision begins to apply

examples.en: I checked when the decision takes effect in the sample notice.
examples.zh: 我查了通知样本里写的「决定开始生效」时间。

examples.en: The letter gave a separate date for when the decision takes effect.
examples.zh: 信件单独列出了「决定开始生效」的日期。

collocations: the decision takes effect on the date stated
confirm when the decision takes effect

words.enDefinition: A status indicating a later decision replaces an earlier one

examples.en: The earlier notice was marked decision superseded in the online record.
examples.zh: 在线记录把较早那份通知标记为「原决定已被取代」。

examples.en: I asked what decision superseded meant in the list of notices.
examples.zh: 我问通知列表里的「原决定已被取代」是什么意思。

collocations: show a record as decision superseded

words.enDefinition: A replacement notice fixing an error in a previously issued one

examples.en: The agency sent a corrected notice after checking the spelling.
examples.zh: 政务机构核对拼写后发来了「更正后的通知」。

examples.en: I kept the corrected notice with the original in my folder.
examples.zh: 我把「更正后的通知」与原通知一起放在文件夹里。

words.enDefinition: An official decision changed after the original was issued

examples.en: The amended decision replaced one condition listed in the original.
examples.zh: 「修订后的决定」更改了原决定中所列的一项条件。

examples.en: I read the amended decision beside the earlier version of the decision.
examples.zh: 我把「修订后的决定」和较早的版本放在一起看。

words.enDefinition: A brief account of an official decision and its main points

examples.en: The decision summary introduced the key findings before the longer explanation.
examples.zh: 「决定概要」在详细说明前先列出了主要审理结论。

examples.en: I took note of the reference on the decision summary.
examples.zh: 我记下了「决定概要」上的编号。

words.enDefinition: The formal outcome or manner in which a case ends

examples.en: The US form listed case disposition as its final field.
examples.zh: 美国的表格把「案件处理结果」列为最后一栏。

examples.en: The clerk explained how the case disposition appeared in the register.
examples.zh: 办事员解释了「案件处理结果」在登记册中是怎样呈现的。

words.enDefinition: A message formally advising that an agency has closed a case

examples.en: I received a case closure notice after the status changed online.
examples.zh: 在线状态变更后，我收到了一份「案件结案通知」。

examples.en: The agency kept the case closure notice under the original case number.
examples.zh: 政务机构把「案件结案通知」归在原来的案件编号下。

collocations: a copy of the case closure notice

words.enDefinition: A notice label indicating a tribunal or authority dismissed a case

examples.en: The register showed case dismissed on the line below the hearing date.
examples.zh: 登记册在听证日期下一行显示「案件已驳回」。

examples.en: I checked which order accompanied the message case dismissed that morning.
examples.zh: 我核对了那天早上写有「案件已驳回」的消息附的是哪份命令。

words.enDefinition: To formally inform everyone directly involved in a proceeding

examples.en: The clerk explained when the tribunal would notify the parties after the hearing.
examples.zh: 办事员解释了听证后审裁机构会在什么时候「通知各方当事人」。

examples.en: The office said it would notify the parties through its message centre.
examples.zh: 办事处说，会通过消息中心「通知各方当事人」。

collocations: notify the parties of the decision

words.enDefinition: A mistake made while an office processes or records something

examples.en: The letter said an administrative error had affected the date recorded.
examples.zh: 信中说，「行政处理错误」影响了记录的日期。

examples.en: The clerk checked whether the discrepancy was an administrative error.
examples.zh: 办事员核对了这处不一致是否属于「行政处理错误」。

words.enDefinition: A change fixing a recording or typing error in an official record

examples.en: The office noted a clerical correction beside the corrected spelling.
examples.zh: 办事处在更正后的拼写旁标明已作「文书错误更正」。

examples.en: I asked whether the clerical correction had changed the original date.
examples.zh: 我问「文书错误更正」是否改动了原先的日期。

words.enDefinition: Words indicating that an authority withdrew a previous notice

examples.en: The portal showed notice withdrawn next to the outdated correspondence.
examples.zh: 政务平台在旧函件旁显示「通知已撤回」。

examples.en: I asked which notice the label notice withdrawn referred to.
examples.zh: 我问「通知已撤回」这个标签指哪份通知。

collocations: confirm that the notice was withdrawn

words.enDefinition: A formal review of a decision through an administrative process

examples.en: The UK guide listed administrative review under the decision section.
examples.zh: 英国指南把「行政复核」列在决定一节里。

examples.en: I asked which notice explained the meaning of administrative review here.
examples.zh: 我问哪份通知解释了这里的「行政复核」是什么意思。

words.enDefinition: A review conducted within the body that made the original decision

examples.en: The agency listed internal review as a separate type of review.
examples.zh: 政务机构把「机构内部复核」单列为一种复核方式。

examples.en: The letter identified the team responsible for the internal review.
examples.zh: 信件写明了负责「机构内部复核」的团队。

words.enDefinition: Reconsideration of a decision's facts, law, and merits by a reviewer

examples.en: The Australian guide explained the purpose of merits review in plain language.
examples.zh: 澳大利亚指南用通俗语言解释了「实质复核」的目的。

examples.en: I asked what the term merits review meant in the tribunal's notice.
examples.zh: 我问审裁机构通知中的「实质复核」是什么意思。

words.enDefinition: A court's examination of whether an official decision was lawful

examples.en: The booklet explained the role of the court in judicial review.
examples.zh: 手册解释了法院在「司法审查」中的作用。

examples.en: The notice used the phrase judicial review in a separate section.
examples.zh: 通知在单独一节使用了「司法审查」这个说法。

words.enDefinition: A formal request asking an authority to examine its decision again

examples.en: The agency acknowledged my reconsideration request with a separate letter.
examples.zh: 政务机构另发了一封信，确认收到了我的「重新考虑请求」。

examples.en: I checked which decision the reconsideration request referred to in the record.
examples.zh: 我核对了记录中的「重新考虑请求」涉及哪项决定。

words.zhGloss: 英国福利决定重新审议
words.enDefinition: A UK process for reconsidering certain benefits decisions within the department
acceptedZhAnswers: 英国福利决定重新审议

examples.en: The UK leaflet used mandatory reconsideration in the section on benefits.
examples.zh: 英国说明单在福利一节用了「英国福利决定重新审议」这一术语。

examples.en: I asked which part of the guide described mandatory reconsideration.
examples.zh: 我问指南哪一部分介绍了「英国福利决定重新审议」。

words.zhGloss: 英国福利重审结果通知
words.enDefinition: A UK notice giving the outcome of a benefits reconsideration
acceptedZhAnswers: 英国福利重审结果通知

examples.en: The UK example showed a mandatory reconsideration notice with the result at the top.
examples.zh: 英国示例的「英国福利重审结果通知」把结果印在顶部。

examples.en: I checked which decision was named in the mandatory reconsideration notice.
examples.zh: 我核对了「英国福利重审结果通知」提到的是哪项决定。

collocations: a copy of a mandatory reconsideration notice

words.enDefinition: A request to USCIS to reopen a case using new facts

examples.en: The US guide put motion to reopen and reconsideration in separate sections.
examples.zh: 美国指南把「申请重开案件的动议」和重新考虑分开介绍。

examples.en: I asked what a motion to reopen meant in the sample notice.
examples.zh: 我问通知样本中的「申请重开案件的动议」指什么。

collocations: a decision on a motion to reopen

words.enDefinition: A request to USCIS alleging it applied law or policy incorrectly

examples.en: The adviser explained how the guide defined a motion to reconsider.
examples.zh: 顾问解释了指南怎样定义「申请复议的动议」。

examples.en: I found the motion to reconsider heading in the US reference booklet.
examples.zh: 我在美国参考手册中找到了「申请复议的动议」这个标题。

collocations: a ruling on a motion to reconsider

words.enDefinition: A formal document notifying the relevant body that an appeal is made

examples.en: The clerk placed the notice of appeal beside the original decision letters.
examples.zh: 办事员把「申诉通知书」放在原决定函旁边。

examples.en: I checked which case number appeared on the notice of appeal.
examples.zh: 我核对了「申诉通知书」上写的是哪个案件编号。

collocations: a copy of a notice of appeal

words.enDefinition: An independent body authorized to hear certain appeals

examples.en: The notice named the appeal tribunal at the top of the page.
examples.zh: 通知在页首列出了「申诉审裁机构」。

examples.en: I asked which appeal tribunal had issued the final order.
examples.zh: 我问最后的命令是哪家「申诉审裁机构」出具的。

collocations: a hearing before an appeal tribunal

words.enDefinition: An administrative office that maintains records for a tribunal

examples.en: The tribunal registry confirmed it had received the document that morning.
examples.zh: 「审裁机构登记处」确认，当天上午已收到文件。

examples.en: I asked which part of the letter came from the tribunal registry.
examples.zh: 我问信中哪一部分来自「审裁机构登记处」。

collocations: a letter from the tribunal registry
records held by the tribunal registry

words.enDefinition: A written message giving information about an upcoming formal hearing

examples.en: The hearing notice listed the hearing location on its first page.
examples.zh: 「听证会通知」在第一页列出了听证地点。

examples.en: I kept the hearing notice in the file with my other letters.
examples.zh: 我把「听证会通知」和其他信件放在同一份案卷里。

words.enDefinition: A preliminary hearing to arrange how a case will proceed

examples.en: The tribunal described the directions hearing before explaining the final hearing.
examples.zh: 审裁机构先介绍了「程序安排听证会」，然后说明最终听证。

examples.en: I checked which case was listed for the directions hearing.
examples.zh: 我核对了「程序安排听证会」列的是哪个案件。

words.enDefinition: Formal instructions organizing the steps and handling of a case

examples.en: The case management directions set out the schedule in a separate paragraph.
examples.zh: 「案件程序指示」在单独一段中列明了安排。

examples.en: I asked which document contained the case management directions for that hearing.
examples.zh: 我问哪份文件包含那次听证的「案件程序指示」。

collocations: a copy of the case management directions

words.enDefinition: A review based on written documents without an oral hearing

examples.en: The Australian guide described a review on the papers as one possible format.
examples.zh: 澳大利亚指南把「仅凭书面材料复核」介绍为一种可能的形式。

examples.en: I asked what the notice meant by a review on the papers.
examples.zh: 我问通知里说的「仅凭书面材料复核」指什么。

collocations: conduct a review on the papers
a decision after a review on the papers
a notice about a review on the papers

words.enDefinition: Written statements from a party setting out views or arguments

examples.en: The tribunal listed the written submissions it had received from both sides.
examples.zh: 审裁机构列出了从双方收到的「书面陈述材料」。

examples.en: I saved the written submissions in a separate folder from the evidence.
examples.zh: 我把「书面陈述材料」和证据分开放在两个文件夹里。

words.enDefinition: Arguments or explanations given aloud to a decision-making body

examples.en: The notice mentioned oral submissions separately from the written papers.
examples.zh: 通知把「口头陈述意见」和书面文件分开提及。

examples.en: The clerk checked when the oral submissions had been recorded.
examples.zh: 办事员核对了「口头陈述意见」是什么时候记入记录的。

words.enDefinition: Statements addressing points another party has already presented

examples.en: The case summary listed the submissions in reply after the earlier statements.
examples.zh: 案件概要在较早的陈述后面列出了「回应对方的陈述材料」。

examples.en: I checked which page contained the submissions in reply from our side.
examples.zh: 我核对了我方的「回应对方的陈述材料」在哪一页。

collocations: an exchange of submissions in reply

words.enDefinition: The person or body that issued the initial decision

examples.en: The notice named the original decision-maker and the new reviewer separately.
examples.zh: 通知把「作出原决定的人」和新的复核人员分开列出。

examples.en: I asked which office the original decision-maker had worked in.
examples.zh: 我问「作出原决定的人」当时在哪个办事处工作。

collocations: the name of the original decision-maker

words.enDefinition: To leave an earlier decision unchanged after reviewing it

examples.en: The Australian leaflet explained what it means to affirm the decision.
examples.zh: 澳大利亚的说明单解释了「维持该项决定」是什么意思。

examples.en: The written outcome showed that the tribunal chose to affirm the decision.
examples.zh: 书面结果显示审裁机构选择「维持该项决定」。

collocations: a tribunal may affirm the decision
state whether to affirm the decision

words.enDefinition: To change part of an earlier decision during review

examples.en: The example showed a tribunal deciding to vary the decision on review.
examples.zh: 示例中，审裁机构在复核时决定「变更部分决定内容」。

examples.en: I asked what the guide meant by choosing to vary the decision.
examples.zh: 我问指南所说的决定「变更部分决定内容」是什么意思。

collocations: an order to vary the decision

words.enDefinition: To remove the legal effect of an earlier decision

examples.en: The Australian decision summary explained what it meant to set aside the decision.
examples.zh: 澳大利亚的决定概要解释了「撤销该项决定」是什么意思。

examples.en: The order recorded the panel's decision to set aside the decision that afternoon.
examples.zh: 命令记录了小组当天下午决定「撤销该项决定」。

collocations: decide to set aside the decision
an order to set aside the decision
a tribunal may set aside the decision

words.enDefinition: To place a new decision in place of the earlier one

examples.en: The guide showed how an order could substitute a new decision on review.
examples.zh: 指南展示了复核时怎样通过一项命令「改作一项新决定」。

examples.en: I asked why the notice said the panel would substitute a new decision.
examples.zh: 我问通知为什么说小组将「改作一项新决定」。

collocations: decide to substitute a new decision
choose to substitute a new decision
a tribunal may substitute a new decision

words.enDefinition: To send a case back to the responsible body for reconsideration

examples.en: The Australian guide used remit the matter for one type of outcome.
examples.zh: 澳大利亚指南用「把案件发回重审」描述一种结果。

examples.en: The tribunal decided to remit the matter to the original agency.
examples.zh: 审裁机构决定「把案件发回原政务机构重审」。

collocations: an order to remit the matter

words.enDefinition: To decide in favor of all or part of an appeal

examples.en: The panel explained its decision to allow the appeal in the last paragraph.
examples.zh: 小组在最后一段解释了为什么决定「判申诉成立」。

examples.en: I read why the tribunal chose to allow the appeal after reviewing the papers.
examples.zh: 我读了审裁机构审查书面材料后决定「判申诉成立」的理由。

collocations: a tribunal may allow the appeal
an order to allow the appeal

words.enDefinition: To reject an appeal so it does not change the decision

examples.en: The decision letter explained why the tribunal would dismiss the appeal.
examples.zh: 决定函解释了审裁机构为什么会「驳回申诉」。

examples.en: I checked which panel had decided to dismiss the appeal in that case.
examples.zh: 我核对了是哪个小组决定「驳回申诉」的。

collocations: an order to dismiss the appeal

words.enDefinition: A status indicating a hearing has been postponed or paused

examples.en: The online record showed hearing adjourned beside the original hearing date.
examples.zh: 在线记录在原听证日期旁显示「听证延期」。

examples.en: We received a short notice stating hearing adjourned later that afternoon.
examples.zh: 当天下午晚些时候，我们收到一份写着「听证延期」的简短通知。

words.enDefinition: A meeting about organizing the steps of a case

examples.en: The letter listed a case management conference before the hearing information.
examples.zh: 信件先列了「案件程序协调会议」，再写听证信息。

examples.en: I checked which issue the case management conference was meant to discuss.
examples.zh: 我核对了「案件程序协调会议」要讨论哪个问题。

words.enDefinition: An explanation of what an official decision or its wording means

examples.en: The office sent an interpretation of the decision in a separate letter.
examples.zh: 办事处另发了一封信，提供了「对决定的解释」。

examples.en: I used the guide to check the interpretation of the decision we received.
examples.zh: 我用指南核对了我们收到的「对决定的解释」。

collocations: ask for an interpretation of the decision
give an interpretation of the decision
a written interpretation of the decision

words.enDefinition: An agency label for a notification that did not arrive

examples.en: The US portal listed non-delivery of notice as a separate inquiry category.
examples.zh: 美国政务平台把「未收到通知」单列为一种咨询类别。

examples.en: I asked which letter the non-delivery of notice message referred to.
examples.zh: 我问「未收到通知」的消息指的是哪封信。

collocations: an inquiry about non-delivery of notice

words.enDefinition: A status indicating that a notice can be viewed online

examples.en: My account showed "Notice available online" above the link to the letter.
examples.zh: 我的账户在信件链接上方显示「可在线查看通知」。

examples.en: I saw "Notice available online" beside the entry for my latest decision.
examples.zh: 我在最新决定的条目旁看见了「可在线查看通知」。

collocations: a message saying notice available online
a status marked notice available online

words.enDefinition: A formal decision made while a case is still ongoing

examples.en: The tribunal sent an interim decision before the case had concluded.
examples.zh: 案件结束前，审裁机构发出了一项「阶段性决定」。

examples.en: I read the interim decision together with the later final determination.
examples.zh: 我把「阶段性决定」和后来作出的最终裁定放在一起读。

words.enDefinition: An official account of the steps and events in a case

examples.en: The clerk found the hearing entry in the record of proceedings.
examples.zh: 办事员在「审理程序记录」中找到了听证的条目。

examples.en: I compared my saved notice with the record of proceedings on file.
examples.zh: 我把自己保存的通知与归档的「审理程序记录」作了核对。

collocations: an entry in the record of proceedings

words.enDefinition: To formally allow an appeal to proceed to consideration

examples.en: The preliminary order explained whether the tribunal would grant permission to appeal.
examples.zh: 初步命令说明了审裁机构是否会「准许提出申诉」。

examples.en: I checked why the panel chose to grant permission to appeal that morning.
examples.zh: 我查看了小组那天上午选择「准许提出申诉」的原因。

collocations: decide to grant permission to appeal
a tribunal may grant permission to appeal
an order to grant permission to appeal

words.enDefinition: A formal notice that a party is ending its proceeding

examples.en: The clerk added the notice of discontinuance to the case record.
examples.zh: 办事员把「终止程序通知书」放进了案件记录。

examples.en: I checked which request was identified on the notice of discontinuance.
examples.zh: 我核对了「终止程序通知书」指的是哪项请求。

collocations: a copy of a notice of discontinuance

words.enDefinition: With formal permission granted by the body hearing a case

examples.en: The example said a late document was accepted with leave of the tribunal.
examples.zh: 示例说明，那份晚交的文件「经审裁机构许可」被接收。

examples.en: I asked what the phrase with leave of the tribunal meant in the directions.
examples.zh: 我问程序指示中的「经审裁机构许可」是什么意思。

collocations: file a document with leave of the tribunal
proceed with leave of the tribunal
be allowed with leave of the tribunal

words.enDefinition: A status indicating that the agency has reached a decision

examples.en: The dashboard read "Decision has been made." The notice itself was posted later.
examples.zh: 案件总览先显示「决定已作出」，通知晚些时候才发布。

examples.en: I saw "Decision has been made" in the latest update on my file.
examples.zh: 我在案卷的最新进度中看到了「决定已作出」。

collocations: a status reading decision has been made
show that a decision has been made
a message saying decision has been made

words.enDefinition: Brief records made by officials while handling an individual case

examples.en: The officer found my earlier message mentioned in the case notes.
examples.zh: 工作人员在「案件办理记录」里找到了对我先前那条消息的记载。

examples.en: The adviser explained which date appeared in the case notes.
examples.zh: 顾问说明了「案件办理记录」里显示的是哪个日期。

collocations: an entry in the case notes
